title: Kth Largest Element
description:
Find the k-th largest element of an array. Duplicates count separately: in [5, 5, 4] the 2nd largest element is 5.

Input format
Line 1: n and k separated by a space.
Line 2: n integers.

Output format
One integer: the k-th largest element.
constraints: 1 <= k <= n <= 100000. Values fit in a 32-bit signed integer.
hints: If the array were sorted in descending order, where would the k-th largest element sit?
Sorting solves it in O(n log n). Take the element at index k-1 of the descending order.
A min-heap of size k gives O(n log k): push each value and pop the smallest whenever the heap grows beyond k. The heap top is the answer. Do not remove duplicates.
